_comment: Composants livres avec la version Windows (source commune de make-sbom.ps1 et check-vulnerabilities.ps1). La version et la somme de ffmpeg viennent de scripts/package-installer.ps1 ($ffVersion, $ffSha256). Mettre ce fichier a jour avec THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

components.name: FFmpeg (essentials build, gyan.dev)
components.comment: ffmpeg.exe is installed next to the program by the installer (and downloaded on request by the portable archive after a SHA-256 check).

components.name: TweetNaCl (adapted: Ed25519 and SHA-512 in src/core/ed25519.cpp)
components.supplier: Person: Daniel J. Bernstein et al.
components.comment: Public domain; the code is compiled into ShaderToMP4.exe.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ run-time library (statically linked, /MT)
components.comment: Redistributable under the Microsoft run-time license; linked into ShaderToMP4.exe.

components.name: SPIRV-Cross
components.comment: tools/spirv-cross.exe, separate process; built by scripts/build-xlang-tools.ps1.

components.name: naga-cli
components.comment: tools/naga.exe, separate process; built by cargo install --locked.

components.name: DirectX Shader Compiler
components.comment: Not shipped: downloaded on request by --get-dxc (SHA-256 checked) into tools/dxc/.
